name: SSHI_SeriesL_Filter
rationale: The SSHI_LC_Filter was very close to passing but failed on ripple (48-74mV), needing <20mV. To reduce ripple without increasing output capacitance (which slows startup 'tup' and settling 'dv'), I am increasing the total filter inductance by placing two inductors L2 and L3 in series. This increases the total inductance to potentially 20mH, reducing the current ripple. By using a single output capacitor C1 instead of an intermediate one (as in the DoubleL filter), I keep the total capacitance low enough to meet the startup and settling time requirements.
